children: The Malaysian healthcare sector is poised for continued growth as private hospital operators expand capacity to meet rising demand from an ageing population, more complex medical needs and medical tourism, Maybank Investment Bank analyst Nur Natasha Ariza says in a note. While the growing pipeline of new hospitals raises concerns about increasing competition, the impact is expected to remain confined to specific regions rather than broad-based, she says. While new hospitals offer longer-term growth opportunities, expansions of existing hospitals and daycare facilities could provide more immediate opportunities to maximize returns from existing assets, she adds. Maybank maintains a positive rating on the Malaysian healthcare sector, naming IHH Healthcare as its top sector pick. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
